text:
Type: wall cube and low shelf storage combination
Use: storing books, media and decor across a wall; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, modern, minimalist
Materials: white and dark grey finished board, white doors, white metal legs
Colors: white, dark charcoal grey
Shape: staggered cluster of open and doored square wall cubes above two long low open shelf units on slim legs, asymmetric compartments, playful checkerboard layout, wide and spread out
Feel: graphic, playful, orderly, light
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, black and grey accents, plants; Scandinavian or modern living rooms
